# 666DEV Operations Center · R01

This is a **666DEV-native view skill**, not a second native runtime. It is
read-only by default and MUST use the current 666DEV GitHub branch, registry,
project profile and native LiveCircle before describing a live project.

- Native projection: `src/devhub/intelligence/operations.py`.
- Windows endpoint: `GET /api/operations-center?project=<id>` on loopback.
- Six presentations: Operations Center, CodeForge, Repo Mind, LiveCircle,
  Visual Intelligence and Windows Control.
- Sub-LifeCircle entries are projections of existing working/current pointers,
  not persisted subfacet states; never claim they were independently rehydrated.
- Daemon suggestions are evidence-bound read-only recommendations, not
  permission to run commands. No background daemon has been deployed.
- Missing source => READBACK_PENDING; conflicting native state =>
  CONFLICT_QUARANTINE; no selected project => OFFEN.
- No external tool, native write, Current mutation, plugin release or
  target-system activation follows from opening a menu.
- Keep SOURCE, LOCAL TEST, CI, DELIVERY, ADOPTION and HOST separate.
- Preserve the existing Windows Visualformen and native UI Handoff.
- When a direct 666DEV UPDATE targets the hub, check affected Windows
  features, native integration tests and independent readback.

Follow `docs/livecircle.md` for authority and `windows-app/README.md`
for host behavior. Cross-system CLIC/LYVRA/PFS/STREAM/MAIN BRAIN documents
are technical references only, not authority or live imported facets.
